title: Deciding finite-algebra congruence-lattice representability
exact_target: Does an algorithm exist that, on every order table of a finite nonempty lattice L, halts and determines whether L is isomorphic to Con(A) for some finite algebra A with arbitrary finitary operations?
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
\paragraph{Statement recorded in the supplied source.}
Does an algorithm exist that, on every order table of a finite nonempty lattice L, halts and determines whether L is isomorphic to Con(A) for some finite algebra A with arbitrary finitary operations?

\subsection{Short English statement}
